name: MongoDB for Startups Credits
free_limit: Approved early-stage and funded startups may receive non-recurring MongoDB Atlas promotional credits and Voyage AI tokens, with tier-dependent award sizes, technical advice and possible partner perks; exact credit amounts depend on the approved tier.
watch_out: Must apply and receive a promo code; publicly listed program tiers do not promise a uniform cash amount. Promo codes must be activated within 12 months and Atlas credits generally expire 12 months after activation; extensions are discretionary. Billing beyond promotional credit and optional Developer Support can incur charges. Payment-card and commercial-use terms are not stated clearly.
